_meta.description: The Socrata MCP server's own report (initialize's serverInfo) and its tools/list, at a stated commit of its repository, started with an empty environment. The City Record pack's basePins are read from it: serverInfo's name and version, and mcpToolSchemaSha256 of get_data and fetch.
_meta.install: git clone over HTTPS into a fresh directory under the OS temporary directory, the commit checked out detached; npm ci --ignore-scripts; npm run build:tsc
_meta.transport: stdio: node dist/index.js --stdio, the working directory the clone (no .env), the environment empty

tools.name: get_data
tools.title: Unified Socrata Access
tools.description: A unified tool to interact with Socrata open-data portals.

query.description: General search phrase OR a full SoQL query string. If this is a full SoQL query (e.g., starts with SELECT), other SoQL parameters like select, where, q might be overridden or ignored by the handler in favor of the full SoQL query. If it's a search phrase, it will likely be used for a full-text search ($q parameter to Socrata).

domain.description: The Socrata domain to query: the host of the portal this call is about. Required on every call, because this server has no default portal configured; a call without one is refused.

portal.description: Alias for domain — the Socrata portal domain

limit.description: Number of results to return (e.g., "10", "100"), or "all". For type "query", at most 10,000 rows per call: a larger number is reduced to 10,000, and "all" returns up to 10,000 rows, with next_offset when more remain.

q.description: Full-text search query within the dataset (used in data access)

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search (no default portal configured)
tools.description: Search a configured default portal and return matching dataset IDs. This server has no default portal configured, so search is refused; to find datasets on a portal you name, use get_data with type "catalog", a "query" and that portal's host as "domain".

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch Document
tools.description: Retrieve full dataset metadata or record content from a Socrata open data portal. This server has no default portal configured, so the identifier must name its portal: dataset:<portal-host>:<dataset-id>, record:<portal-host>:<dataset-id>:<row-id>, or the dataset's URL.

id.description: Identifier returned by the search tool
